scope: Finite-group Lemma 1, cyclic-isotropy Corollary 2, and isotropy-to-nine-flex-fiber interface only
strongest_verified_claim: For the actual Hessian group Gamma in PU(3), every element fixing no flex has simple spectrum; every Gamma intersect g^-1 H g for H=diag(1,z,z) has one common fixed flex, giving a section over each H-orbit of PU(3)/Gamma.
scope_boundary_example: C has monodromy 1^3 3^2: it fixes three sheets while permuting six, so a one-flex section does not imply full-nine-sheet trivialization.
